_doc: 植入式 A/B 基准的错误库。每条给出：错误描述（判定用的标准答案）与植入方式。由 tools/fault_injection_benchmark.py 消费。

_inject_modes.append: 在正文约 position 处插入一段（用于加入新的错误陈述）
_inject_modes.replace: 把 find 替换成 faulty（用于改动已有内容，最自然，但依赖宿主含有该串）

_note: 植入的错误必须与宿主论文**同语言、同文风、不新起标题**，否则模型只要挑出「外来段落」就能逐条读，基准会饱和（两臂都满分）。实测教训：中文段落插进英文论文，裸模型直接在意见里起了个小标题叫「插入的中文实验段落（逐条）」—— 它是在挑外来物，不是在审稿。

faults.description: 论文报告 t(10) = 2.228 对应 P = 0.001，但该统计量与自由度对应的双尾 P 值约为 0.05，统计量与 P 值对不上

inject.faulty: Between-group differences in tumour volume were assessed with a two-tailed independent-samples t-test. Tumour volume differed significantly between groups (t(10) = 2.228, P = 0.001), whereas body weight did not (t(10) = 0.51, P = 0.62).

faults.description: 在 n=10 的整数量表（0–10 整数评分，每人一个分数）下报告均值 3.14，这在数学上不可能：10 个整数之和除以 10 只能得到一位小数

inject.faulty: Symptom severity was rated by each participant on an 11-point integer numeric rating scale, with one score per participant (n = 10). Mean symptom score was 3.14 (SD 1.20) in the treated group and 5.70 (SD 1.40) in controls (P = 0.002).

faults.description: 报告的点估计 20.0 μM 落在其自身报告的 95% 置信区间 [9.8, 15.7] 之外，点估计与区间不自洽

inject.faulty: Concentration-response data were fitted with a four-parameter logistic model, yielding IC50 = 20.0 uM (95% CI 9.8-15.7 uM) with R2 = 0.98.

faults.description: 伪重复：每组 6 只动物、每只取 10 个视野，却把 60 个视野当作统计学 n，技术重复冒充生物学重复

inject.faulty: Six animals per group were analysed, with ten randomly selected fields imaged per animal. The proportion of positive cells differed between groups (n = 60 per group, independent-samples t-test, P < 0.001).

faults.description: 用 Pearson 相关系数证明两种测量方法「一致」：r 高只说明线性相关，不说明一致，应做 Bland-Altman 分析

inject.faulty: Agreement between the new non-invasive assay and the established reference method was evaluated by Pearson correlation. The two methods were highly correlated (r = 0.95, P < 0.001), indicating good agreement and supporting substitution of the new assay in clinical use.

faults.description: 生存数据忽略删失：用独立样本 t 检验比较两组中位生存期，且明确存在失访，应用 Kaplan-Meier + log-rank

inject.faulty: Overall survival was recorded over 36 months of follow-up. Median survival was compared between arms using an independent-samples t-test (18.2 vs 14.6 months, P = 0.03). Twelve patients in the treated arm and fifteen in the control arm were lost to follow-up.

faults.description: 剂量单位量纲混淆：方法节为 50 mg/kg/day 连续 14 天（累积 700 mg/kg），结果节却把它当作总暴露量 50 mg/kg 与 NOAEL 200 mg/kg 直接比较

inject.faulty: Animals in the high-dose group received the test compound at 50 mg/kg/day for 14 consecutive days. Total exposure in this group (50 mg/kg) remained well below the reported no-observed-adverse-effect level of 200 mg/kg, indicating a wide safety margin.

faults.description: 变异 p.Arg273His 的位置 273 超出论文自己给出的 60 个残基的序列长度，位置越界

inject.faulty: The truncated construct used throughout comprises 60 residues (MEEPQSDPSVEPPLSQETFSDLWKLLPENNVLSPLPSQAMDDLMLSPDDIEQWFTEDPGP). The p.Arg273His substitution was introduced into this construct by site-directed mutagenesis and the mutant protein was expressed and purified.

faults.description: 小鼠基因符号书写错误：小鼠基因应按 MGI 惯例首字母大写（Trp53、Brca1、Il6、Actb），论文却用了人类 HGNC 的全大写写法

inject.faulty: Mouse embryonic fibroblasts were isolated from C57BL/6J mice. Expression of the mouse genes TP53, BRCA1 and IL6 was quantified by qPCR and normalised to mouse ACTB.

faults.description: 临床试验注册号格式非法：NCT 号应为 NCT 后接 8 位数字，论文写的 NCT123 位数不足

inject.faulty: The clinical validation component of this study was registered at ClinicalTrials.gov under registration number NCT123.

faults.description: 涉及小鼠在体实验，但全文未报告动物伦理委员会（IACUC）批准与批件号

inject.faulty: Female C57BL/6 mice (6-8 weeks, n = 8 per group) received the test compound or vehicle by intraperitoneal injection for 14 consecutive days, after which tumour tissue was collected for immunohistochemical analysis.

faults.description: 关键对照缺失：siRNA 敲低实验只有敲低组与未处理组，缺少非靶向对照（scrambled / NC siRNA）

inject.faulty: Cells were transfected with siRNA targeting the gene of interest and harvested after 48 h; untransfected cells served as the control. Western blotting showed markedly reduced target protein in the siRNA group relative to untransfected cells (P < 0.01), with a 40% reduction in proliferation.

faults.description: 结论层级越界：仅有细胞系体外数据，却直陈该化合物是有效的临床治疗药物并应尽快用于临床

inject.faulty: Taken together, these cell-line experiments establish the antiproliferative activity of the compound (IC50 = 12.4 uM). The compound is an effective therapeutic agent for this disease and should be moved into clinical use without delay.

faults.description: 不显著误读为无差异：P = 0.31、每组 n = 8 且无效能分析，却结论「该化合物对肿瘤生长无影响」

inject.faulty: Eight animals per group were used to compare tumour volume between the test compound and vehicle; no power analysis was performed. The difference was not statistically significant (P = 0.31). The compound therefore has no effect on tumour growth.
